Correct encoded lower-bound checks to send_with_attachments only; upload encoded requests remain PR5 validation. Preserve all baseline tests; adjust only new PR4 specifications that assumed uploaded bytes appeared in published messages and add explicit mode-interaction regression. No transport/MIME sizing implementation.

No new persistence/state machine/post-commit operations. Alternate paths validate acquired size drift and direct-send encoded lower bounds. D/pre-existing defects: none attributed to PR4. F/gaps: executor/provider requests/SMTP MIME and external adapter declarations deliberately deferred to zaq-9j8; no provider acceptance claimed. G/previous findings: fixed upload-batch actual-size validation and encoded-mode interaction fully resolved by focused tests. H/hygiene: only owning channels docs changed; no baseline test edits, dependency pins, source-reference edits or unrelated files. Quality domain grade unchanged. I/verdict: approve PR4 implementation for dedicated coverage handoff; no known reproducible in-scope correctness blocker. Latest mix q PASS; final focused suites 49 PASS (7 properties), prior compatibility suites 293 PASS and materialization suites 68 PASS. No browser E2E applies to backend-only primitives.
